notes: Eligibility, English-score and fee details of the Application Guides (IGP(A)/(C), regular science-and-engineering master's, medical/dental/MPH/nursing master's) are published only as PDF downloads, which the snapshot tool cannot read into text, so none of them could be quoted. Only HTML pages (IGP pages, IGP FAQ) are quoted; the regular Japanese-language master's entrance examination, the Nursing Innovation Science master's, and the PDF-only requirements remain uncollected. The two Medical and Dental master's programs are listed with no verified fields. IGP(B) is doctoral-only and excluded.
